name: Optimize marlang fib(40) to match bun performance

description: Baseline: marlang 37.58s vs bun 0.39s (97x slower). JIT rejects Op::Call so fib runs in interpreter only.
Enable JIT for self-recursive Op::Call + skip dead PushGlobal for self-callees. 37.58s → 0.76s (49.5x faster, now 2x bun).
Fuse comparison+JumpIfFalse peephole in JIT. 0.758s → 0.746s (marginal, likely noise). Cleaner IR generation.
Cache local SSA values within blocks to avoid redundant loads across calls. 0.746s → 0.737s (marginal).
